name: 600 Mbps Cloud Gateways
source_note: Team-derived entry tier based on Ruijie Reyee RG-EG105G-V3 and RG-EG105G-P-V3 specifications, with 600 Mbps advertised gateway throughput. Not a manufacturer-published product-line hierarchy.

name: 1.5 Gbps Cloud Gateways
source_note: Team-derived midrange tier based on the RG-EG305GH-P-E's documented 1.5 Gbps gateway throughput and 350-client capacity. Not a manufacturer-published product-line hierarchy.

name: 3 Gbps High-Performance Gateways
source_note: Team-derived higher-performance tier based on the RG-EG710XS's documented 3 Gbps gateway throughput and 700-client capacity. Not a manufacturer-published product-line hierarchy.

name: ES Smart Managed
source_note: Team-derived tier grouping Reyee ES smart cloud-managed switches, including RG-ES216GC-V2 and RG-ES228GS-LP. PoE variants share the tier because PoE is a functional requirement rather than a universal performance ranking. Not a manufacturer-published hierarchy.

name: NBS Layer 3 Managed
source_note: Team-derived advanced switch tier based on RG-NBS5200-24GT4XS-P-V2, documented as a Layer 3 managed PoE switch with 10G SFP+ uplinks. Not a manufacturer-published hierarchy.

name: Wi-Fi 6 AX3000
source_note: Team-derived AP tier based on the RG-RAP2266 Wi-Fi 6 AX3000 class. Rankings consider wireless generation and advertised data rates, not guaranteed throughput.

name: Wi-Fi 7 BE3600
source_note: Team-derived AP tier based on the RG-RAP72 Wi-Fi 7 BE3600 class. Higher rank reflects newer wireless generation and advertised performance class.

name: Wi-Fi 7 BE19000
source_note: Team-derived higher-performance AP tier based on the RG-RAP73HD Wi-Fi 7 tri-radio BE19000 class. Classification reflects advertised wireless capabilities, not guaranteed real-world throughput.
